Ridenfaden Wednesday

Louisville, KY · Germantown

No-drop

Ridenfaden Wednesday is a road and gravel group ride in Louisville, KY. It meets every Wednesday, year-round; no-drop group 6:00 pm, fast ride 6:30 pm, starting at Seidenfaden's. Pace: no-drop group and a fast group.

About the Ridenfaden Wednesday group ride

A year-round Wednesday ride out of a Germantown bar, with a no-drop group at 6 and a fast ride at 6:30. Everyone ends up back at Seidenfaden's by 8. Some race, some slow roll, all fine.
